events.text: The Celts have started worshipping a pantheon of gods. They have chosen the belief: Goddess of the Hunt (+1 [ICON_FOOD] Food from Camps)

The Netherlands have started worshipping a pantheon of gods. They have chosen the belief: Voice of the Surf (+1 [ICON_PEACE] Faith and +1 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture from Atolls, and from [ICON_RES_FISH] Fish, [ICON_RES_WHALE] Whales, [ICON_RES_CRAB] Crab, [ICON_RES_PEARLS] Pearls, Red Caviar, and Caviar resources)

Indonesia has started worshipping a pantheon of gods. They have chosen the belief: God of the Sea (+1 [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production from Fishing Boats and Atolls, a free Work Boat appears near the [ICON_CAPITAL] Capital)

Germany has started worshipping a pantheon of gods. They have chosen the belief: Sun God (+1 [ICON_FOOD] Food for each [ICON_RES_WHEAT] Wheat, Banana, [ICON_RES_CITRUS] Citrus, [ICON_RES_COCOA] Cocoa, and [ICON_RES_PINEAPPLE] Pineapple resource)
Rome has started worshipping a pantheon of gods. They have chosen the belief: One with Nature (+5 [ICON_PEACE] Faith from Natural Wonders)
EVILHAILRAKEGOD has made peace with Anoriel22!
A golden age begins for the Celtic civilization.
A golden age begins for the Indonesian civilization.
A golden age begins for the German civilization.

The Celts have founded the new religion Buddhism in the holy city of Edinburgh:[NEWLINE][COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]World Church[ENDCOLOR] +1 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture for every 6 followers of this religion[NEWLINE][COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]Religious Community[ENDCOLOR] +1% [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production for each follower (max +10%). [ICON_BUILDING_GRAND_TEMPLE] Grand Temple provides +3 [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production

Rome has founded the new religion Taoism in the holy city of Rome:[NEWLINE][COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]Coffers of the Faithful[ENDCOLOR] +1% [ICON_GOLD] Gold in a city for every follower of this religion there, up to a maximum of +15%[NEWLINE][COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]Fukujin's Bounty[ENDCOLOR] [ICON_BUILDING_CARAVANSARY] Caravansaries provide +1 [ICON_HAPPINESS_1] Happiness and +1 [ICON_FOOD] Food. The [ICON_BUILDING_GRAND_EMPORIUM] Grand Emporium provides +3 [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production and +3 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture.
Anoriel22 has proven that the world is round!
A golden age begins for the Roman civilization.
A golden age begins for the Indonesian civilization.

The Aztecs have started worshipping a pantheon of gods. They have chosen the belief: Monument to the Gods (+20% [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production of Ancient/Classical/Medieval Wonders. Ancient/Classical/Medieval Wonders (except National Wonders) provide +1 [ICON_HAPPINESS_1] happiness)
A golden age begins for the Dutch civilization.

Indonesia has founded the new religion Protestantism in the holy city of Jakarta:[NEWLINE][COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]Church Property[ENDCOLOR] +3 [ICON_GOLD] Gold for each city following this religion[NEWLINE][COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]Star Navigation[ENDCOLOR] [ICON_BUILDING_LIGHTHOUSE] Lighthouses provide +2 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture, +1 [ICON_RESEARCH] Science and +1 [ICON_HAPPINESS_1] Happiness.

The Netherlands have founded the new religion Catholicism in the holy city of Amsterdam:[NEWLINE][COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]Tithe[ENDCOLOR] +1 [ICON_GOLD] Gold for every 4 followers of this religion[NEWLINE][COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]Mariners' Blessing[ENDCOLOR] [ICON_BUILDING_LIGHTHOUSE] Lighthouses provide +2 [ICON_GOLD] Gold, +2 [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production and +1 [ICON_HAPPINESS_1] Happiness.

Germany has founded the new religion Judaism in the holy city of Berlin:[NEWLINE][COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]Daily Bread[ENDCOLOR] [ICON_BUILDING_PALACE] Palace provides +6 [ICON_FOOD] Food[NEWLINE][COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]Religious Center[ENDCOLOR] [ICON_BUILDING_TEMPLE] Temples provide +1 [ICON_HAPPINESS_1] Happiness, +2 [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production and +1 [ICON_GOLD] Gold. [ICON_BUILDING_GRAND_TEMPLE] Grand Temple provides +5 [ICON_GOLD] Gold
